title: Long-time behavior of reducible stochastic linear reaction networks: a spectral and structural classification
summary: Exponential ergodicity of stochastic reaction networks has attracted considerable attention in recent years [SIAM J. Appl. Dyn. Syst. 24, 1668-1710 (2025)]. Here, we provide a structural classification of the long-time behavior of reducible stochastic linear reaction networks under the $L^1$-Wasserstein and total variation distances.
